title: Big Trouble In Little China - Storms Unisex Sweater Crewneck Pullover Casual Streetwear Graphic Print
description:
Make chilly days warmer and more comfortable with this Youth Sweatshirt. Designed with extra attention to detail and superior quality, this sweatshirt is the perfect everyday essential for fall and winter wear.

Key Features:

  • Warm & Durable Fabric: Crafted to provide reliable warmth while remaining durable for everyday use.

  • Material & Fabric Details:

    • Fabric weight: 8 oz./yd²

    • 50% Cotton / 50% Polyester blend

    • Balanced warmth and durability for cold weather and daily activities

  • Classic Unisex Fit: Comfortable everyday fit suitable for school, outdoor play, and casual wear, keeping kids cozy and stylish throughout the day.

  • Flexible & Comfortable Design:

    • 1x1 rib with spandex for enhanced stretch and recovery

    • Allows natural movement, ideal for active lifestyles

  • Child Safety Compliance: CPSIA Tracking Label Compliance ensures the highest safety standards for kids.

  • Available Colors: Dark Heather, Forest Green, Garnet, Graphite Heather, Red, Royal, Black, Maroon, Navy, Sport Grey, White.

Care Instructions:

  • Washing: Turn the garment inside out before washing. Hand wash in cold water is preferred. If machine washing, use cold water on a gentle cycle. Use mild, non-abrasive detergent. Avoid bleach or harsh chemicals. Wash dark and light colors separately.

  • Drying: Hang to air dry and avoid direct sunlight to prevent fading. If using a dryer, select low heat or a delicate cycle to protect the print.

  • Ironing: Turn garment inside out before ironing. Use low heat only. Avoid ironing directly on the printed area. A pressing cloth is recommended.
